assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Two equal paired pixel-art REVIEW panels of small original medieval ruined northern city quest spaces. Reference only grey stone, dark timber, outdoor frost and muted warm cloth, not whole-city layout. Coarse crisp clusters, low-detail readable game props, top-down oblique ORTHOGRAPHIC camera, horizontal walls, vertical supports, square not diamond floor grid. LEFT MAE-D03-A: outside a ruined academy, isolated low stone trial bench on stable paving; one small broken nonmagical metal-and-wood sample, one intact detached comparison sample, a closed flat folio with visible binding holes. Ruined arch at back with rope barricade preventing entry to unsafe rubble; no operating machinery, no intact university, no students, no magical crystals. Bench entirely disconnected from old structures, public walking lane in foreground clear. RIGHT MAE-D03-B: very modest open-sided grain-station exit shelter directly on ordinary public road. Front ordinary ration counter has two plain empty bowls, a closed work-shift ledger and three anonymous wooden work tokens; behind low half-divider a separate meeting table with ONE conspicuously empty chair and a loose blank seat plaque lying flat. The ration counter is reachable without crossing meeting area. Two broad open ends let a visitor leave toward the road without attending meeting. No people, names, banners, political insignia or guards; bowls are not proof of payment, chair not consent. Snow only outdoors. No large stockpile, no bed, no readable text/numbers/labels, no watermark. Restrained grey-blue stone, brown timber, cream linen, upper-left lighting.
assets.qa: Detached broken and intact samples, closed folio, roped ruined arch, independent ordinary ration counter and empty meeting chair appear. Clear front lane and right shelter opening visible; left shelter end partly curtained. Three tokens and two bowls are decorative counts, not approved payment/capacity. Camera square-grid intent mostly preserved, no operating university.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original medieval northern damaged-city pixel-art review board, TWO paired independent small quest spaces. Reference only cold grey stone, dark timber, sparse outdoor snow, muted cream cloth, NOT whole city. Crisp coarse readable pixel clusters, top-down-oblique orthographic square-grid view, horizontal facade and vertical posts, not diamond isometric. LEFT MAE-D05-A fireless record sorting corridor under lean-to: low sorting table with three shallow trays of ORIGINAL surviving stitched folios, brown/red/blue thread spines distinguish purpose without writing. All folios closed. Small sealed glass jar containing old paper ash on separate shelf, intact originals not reconstructed. NO FLAME, no smoke. A cold iron brazier with fitted CLOSED lid stands OUTSIDE in distant walled corner separated from papers by stone wall and several clear paving tiles. RIGHT MAE-D05-B attribution review chamber: bright window, two closed flat stitched folios side by side on inspection table with binding holes plainly visible, a detachable blank attribution-slot frame lying EMPTY, small closed private source cabinet. No authentication seal, crystal, signature or completed correction. Main open front door plus separate OPEN side door to public lane, nobody has to pass sorting/fire corner to leave. No people, readable text, numbers, magical light, beds, exposed medical or identity details. Modest sparse furnishings, no normal operating university, no glowing hearth. Neutral review scene, outcomes undecided.
assets.qa: Three stitched folio trays, sealed ash sample, cold covered brazier behind stone separation, paired source folios and empty attribution slot rendered. Right chamber has front/side street exits. Left front gate rendered CLOSED despite requested open return; requires targeted opening before preferred use. No flame or completed correction shown. Perspective has some diagonal drift; original documents not readable.
